about: tomlparse's mutants (wf10 corpus wave 1, PA2): each law's mutant, killed by `ergo test` of its package, and the edits no law or case sees, which TestTOMLParseAgreesWithControl in cmd/ergo (toml-test, documents written from generated trees, and the workload, against the hand Go control) kills.

mutants.name: tomlparse-set-twice-is-a-clash
mutants.rule: A key given a value once more is defined twice (laws Definition.SetOnlyOnce and toml.RedefinedKeysFail).

mutants.name: tomlparse-pass-ignores-the-last-table
mutants.from: if b.nodes[id].form == Elements { b.nodes[id].last } else { id }
mutants.rule: A header below an array of tables goes into its last table (law toml.PrintParsesBack).

mutants.name: tomlparse-2000-is-no-leap-year
mutants.rule: A year divisible by 400 is a leap year, so 2000-02-29 is a date (law toml.PrintParsesBack).

mutants.name: tomlparse-keys-never-quoted
mutants.rule: A key that is not bare prints quoted (law toml.PrintParsesBack).

mutants.name: tomlparse-keys-not-indexed
mutants.rule: A new key is found again by its table and name (laws toml.PrintParsesBack and toml.RedefinedKeysFail).

mutants.name: tomlparse-header-twice-accepted
mutants.rule: A [table] header defines its table once (case twice; toml-test invalid/table/duplicate-*).

mutants.name: tomlparse-dotted-keys-extend-a-header-table
mutants.from:
case (Header, Dot):
		Done[Refusal]{Output: Conflict{Why: "is a table a header defined, which dotted keys cannot extend"}}
mutants.rule: Dotted keys cannot extend a table a header defined (toml-test invalid/table/append-with-dotted-keys-*).

mutants.name: tomlparse-closing-quotes-keep-one-too-few
mutants.rule: Up to two quotes before a multi-line basic string's closing quotes are its text (toml-test valid/string/multiline-quotes).

mutants.name: tomlparse-leading-zero-accepted
mutants.rule: A decimal integer has no leading zero (toml-test invalid/integer/leading-zero-*).

mutants.name: tomlparse-tagged-keys-in-reverse
mutants.rule: json writes a table's keys in byte order (case json; the generated trees' JSON, compared byte for byte). The laws compare Tagged with Tagged, so no law sees the order.

mutants.name: tomlparse-surrogate-escape-accepted
mutants.rule: An escape names a Unicode scalar value, never a surrogate (toml-test invalid/string/bad-uni-esc-*).

mutants.name: tomlparse-utf8-unchecked
mutants.rule: The text must be UTF-8 (toml-test invalid/encoding/*).
